## Public-safety checklist

- [ ] This PR contains no credentials, API keys, tokens, customer/account data or private logs.
- [ ] This PR does not copy or describe private backend source, database/cache schemas, ingestion/scraping logic, deployment topology, operational runbooks, private issues/PRs, or unpublished architecture.
- [ ] Product claims are already public/externally observable or backed by a public DalalOS reference.
- [ ] Examples use placeholders only and contain no live authenticated request material.
- [ ] The change does not imply real-time tick data, brokerage/order execution, investment advice, buy/sell recommendations or target prices.
- [ ] Market-data research tools are described as read-only; the account-scoped watchlist add/remove actions remain the explicit write exception.
- [ ] MCP Registry metadata does not represent this public façade as backend source code.
- [ ] If client UI/setup behavior may change, the PR links to maintained vendor/DalalOS documentation rather than freezing an unverified UI flow.
